I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the settled figure is 100 seats.

Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that morning she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, so this was something she could already see. A seat count isn't a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.

I also pointed Dana to Ilse if she wants it checked against the signed renewal. A North team note says Ilse and Thea Ramaswell signed it on 2026-03-20, with Ilse signing as "acting." In my reply I called Ilse the "acting owner," which goes slightly beyond what the note says.
